facts.design: Small house-style cab with a pyramidal roof on a four-legged steel structure
facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what remains at the site.

notes_for_editor: Location checks out. The NGS datasheet for PID BK3234 (retrieved 2026-10-10) gives NAD 83(1993) 30 56 14.85540 N, 093 40 00.94384 W, about 28 m from the record point 30.9375, -93.66722. The NGS overall height of about 110 ft runs to the top of the roof, not the cab floor, so height_m is left out. The datasheet does not say whether the tower or the survey mark still stands. The gone status rests on the FFLA list alone; no removal date or cause was found in the sources read. The record's agency field has a stray leading comma (see corrections).
